title: Set persistent options for a kernel module
summary: You can configure specific parameters for a kernel module so they are applied every time it loads. This is done via configuration files.

steps.explain: Create a file like /etc/modprobe.d/mymodule.conf and add: options <MODULE_NAME> <PARAM_NAME>=<PARAM_VALUE>

rollback.explain: Delete the file /etc/modprobe.d/mymodule.conf or remove the options line.

warnings: All options for a given module must be on a single line.
If the module is in the initramfs, you may need to regenerate it.
